India-Africa Maitri scheme: UG, PG, PhD, STEM and non-STEM, prohibited Medical, Law and Integrated courses

subject_rule: Limited by exclusions, not by a list: scholarships are for structured courses of one year or more at UG, PG and PhD level, and for certificates or diplomas only in Indian languages and literature, performing or visual arts, and yoga; no scholarships are given 'in the fields of Medical Science; Para-medical courses like Nursing, Physiotherapy, anaesthesia, Lab technicians, etc., Law, Integrated courses such as BALLB (5 Years), B.Sc. & M.Sc. (5 Years) etc.'; IIT B.Tech courses are not offered; Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy are under the separate AYUSH schemes.

programmes.detail: Field group the guidelines allow at certificate/diploma level, for courses of one year or more; applicants upload a video or audio of their performance

notes: No course or programme list could be recorded for the bachelor, master or doctorate level: the guidelines say the list of courses offered by each empanelled university, with admission criteria, is on the ICCR A2A portal, and the portal could not be opened from here (see fetch_problems). Only the four certificate/diploma field groups the guidelines name are recorded (4 rows); these are field groups, not a course list.
The Accra High Commission page says the scheme covers 131 reputed Indian universities and institutes; the guidelines give no number.
Embassy copies of the guidelines are used because the ICCR copy could not be opened; the Djibouti and Chicago copies of the 2026-27 guidelines were read and carry the same field rules.
not_stated: The courses or programmes each empanelled university offers, in any official document readable from here

Whether other schemes run by ICCR (for example Lata Mangeshkar, India-Africa Maitri) have different field lists: the Accra notice says India-Africa Maitri covers STEM and non-STEM streams, with Medical, Law and Integrated courses prohibited
fetch_problems: The ICCR A2A portal and the ICCR website (the portal's list of universities and courses, its university PDF and policy PDF) do not resolve from this machine (host not found), so none of the portal's public lists could be read.
An old embassy PDF titled as a list of institutions where ICCR students study is not a course list and was not used.
